title: Deribit options skew and options flow as ridge features (v8.4 and bf2.3; 2 trials) - registered BEFORE the data exists
registered: 2026-10-21, before research_data/deribit_options was downloaded (src/qpl/live/deribit_options.py, user PC)

features.skew: amount-weighted implied vol of OTM puts (K/S 0.85-0.95, tenor 8-45 d) minus that of OTM calls (K/S 1.05-1.15, 8-45 d), per coin per UTC day; and its 7-day change
features.pcr: log(put amount / call amount), all strikes and tenors, per day
features.callflow: (taker-bought call amount - taker-sold call amount) / total call amount, per day
features.missing: a bucket with no trades that day -> NaN -> 0 after standardising (as every ridge feature)

model: the book's current ridge (v8.4: kb, spot flow, VRP, calendar, vol-scaled target; bf2.3: spot flow, VRP, calendar, raw target) + these 5 features (skew, skew 7d change, pcr, callflow, and pcr 7d change); alpha 10, monthly walk-forward from 2021
why: option skew and option order flow carry information on future crypto returns (e.g. Alexander et al. on Deribit order flow; skew as crash-risk pricing); the VRP (Gen301/303) already showed Deribit implied vols add to the ridge
pass: v8.4: v-book bars (replace_ridge) + strict rule vs 2.750 / 1.324 / 3.896 / 2.428; bf2.3: bf2 bars + strict rule vs 2.506 / 0.313 / 3.985 / 2.298
